commit_message:
fix: rename time to value in bench report charts

The charts now display instruction counts, not time measurements.
Updated field names and axis labels to reflect this:
- ChartPoint.time -> ChartPoint.value
- BarPoint.time -> BarPoint.value
- X-axis label: 'Time (µs)' -> 'Instructions (K)'
pr_title: fix: rename time to value in bench report charts
